LESSON: FRACTIONS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Numbers 1.2 Factors (7 lessons) • divisibility of numbers • composite numbers • 
Topic 1.3: Fractions

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Fractions. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How do we use fractions in daily activities?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. compare fractions in different situations
2. add fractions in different situations
3. subtract fractions in different situations

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

• Today’s maths focus is Fractions.

• Start with objects you can touch or draw — stones, sticks, bottle tops, or drawings in your book.

• Say the steps aloud as you work so you do not skip a stage.

• Check your answer with a second method or by estimating.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At the market, count 10 mangoes and put them in 2 groups of 5.

Example 2: In class, count the desks in your row and write the number in figures and in words.

Example 3: If you have 7 shillings and receive 5 more, you have 12 shillings.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Solve three short problems about Fractions using drawings.
2. Explain one solution to a partner in your own words.
3. Make up one new word problem set in your county or school.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five practice questions and solve them in your book.
2. Show your working clearly — not only the final answer.
3. Teach a younger learner one idea from this lesson with bottle tops or drawings.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Discuss and arrange fractions in increasing and decreasing order using different strategies
2. Arrange fractions in ascending or descending order using fraction cards
3. Use flip cards to discuss reciprocals
4. Play games of creating number puzzles that involve fractions number sequences using IT devices or other materials
5. Creativity and Imagination: as the learner creates puzzles involving fractions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do we use fractions in daily activities?
2. Where do we use fractions in daily activities?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Use objects or drawings when a sum feels hard.
2. Check every answer.
3. Fractions is used in real Kenyan life — market, school, and home.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
